architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib (use React context if needed). Static build with Vite. Mobile-first responsive design.

tickets.title: Landing page (sugi.dev_landing_page_integrated)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch landing page to React. Extract hero section, marquee, showcase cards. Keep exact layout, typography, glass-morphism effects. Use CSS modules for styles.
acceptance_criteria: No external libs for animations (use native CSS/JS)

tickets.title: Portfolio home (sugi.dev_portfolio_home_final)
tickets.description: Build portfolio grid page. Extract work items, badges, project cards. Reuse ShowcaseCard component from TASK-001. Add filtering logic (all/design/dev).
acceptance_criteria: Responsive grid (3 cols desktop, 2 cols tablet, 1 col mobile)

tickets.title: About page (sugi.dev_about_page)
tickets.description: Convert about page. Extract philosophy text, marquee, devos table. Reuse Marquee component from TASK-001. Build DevosTable component for skills data.

tickets.title: Services page (services_sugi.dev)
tickets.description: Build services page. Extract service cards, project inquiry section. Reuse components from TASK-001/TASK-002. Add contact form (static validation only).
acceptance_criteria: Form validation: required fields, email format
Form submission logs to console (no backend)

tickets.title: Work detail page (sugi.dev_work_final)
tickets.description: Build work detail page. Extract project header, image gallery, insights section. Add dynamic routing (/work/:id). Fetch data from portfolio.json.
acceptance_criteria: Dynamic route loads correct project data
Gallery supports swipe gestures (mobile) and arrows (desktop)

tickets.title: Shared components (button, badge, table)
tickets.description: Build reusable components. Extract Button, Badge, DevosTable from reference screens. Support all variants in design (primary/secondary, sizes, colors).
acceptance_criteria: All variants match Stitch screens exactly
Props for size, color, disabled state

tickets.title: Static data and assets
tickets.description: Extract all text, images, icons from Stitch screens. Organize in src/data/ and public/assets/. Create JSON schemas for portfolio, skills, services data.
acceptance_criteria: JSON data matches Stitch content exactly
Icons in SVG format (inline or file)

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Build app shell. Add navigation bar, footer. Set up React Router with routes: /, /portfolio, /about, /services, /work/:id. Add 404 page. Implement dark/light mode toggle (default: dark).
